Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, s As String, i As Long, j As Long
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 100, 50, 120, 60).Name = "A"
    ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 250, 80, 60, 40).Name = "B"
    ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 50, 200, 40, 40).Name = "C"
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        s = TypeName(ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")).Group)
    Case 1
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")).Group
    Case 2
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("B", "A")).Group
    Case 3
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Group
    Case 4
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A")).Group
    Case 5
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")).Group.Name = "G"
    Case 6
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")).Group: s = TypeName(ws.Shapes("Group 4").Ungroup) & "," & ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")).Count
    Case 7
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")).Group: ws.Shapes("Group 4").Ungroup
    Case 8
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")).Group: s = ws.Shapes(1).GroupItems(1).Name & "," & ws.Shapes(1).GroupItems("B").Left & "," & ws.Shapes(1).GroupItems.Count
    Case 9
        ws.Shapes("A").Ungroup
    Case 10
        s = ws.Shapes("C").GroupItems.Count
    Case 11
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "C")).Group
    Case 12
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("B", "C")).Group
    Case 13
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "C")).Group: ws.Shapes("Group 4").Ungroup
    Case 14
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")).Group: ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeOval, 10, 10, 20, 20).Name = "D"
    End Select
    For i = 1 To ws.Shapes.Count: s = s & "|" & ws.Shapes(i).Name & "," & ws.Shapes(i).ID & "," & ws.Shapes(i).Type & "," & ws.Shapes(i).Left & "," & ws.Shapes(i).Top & "," & ws.Shapes(i).Width & "," & ws.Shapes(i).Height: If ws.Shapes(i).Type = msoGroup Then For j = 1 To ws.Shapes(i).GroupItems.Count: s = s & ";" & ws.Shapes(i).GroupItems(j).Name: Next
    Next
    Tried = "ok " & s
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 14
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
